title: Pliers
prompt: Ordinary fixed-pivot pliers grip a rod in a bench fixture. Squeeze applies equal finger effort to the handles. Move hand moves the effort farther from the hinge at fixed jaw contact and finger force, showing increased jaw force. Release opens the jaws. Show the two first-class levers, shared hinge, effort, jaw resistance and moment arms. The hand-position comparison is a labelled teaching adaptation.
blurb: Two fixed-pivot levers grip a rod in a teaching fixture, with a hand-position comparison at equal finger effort.

adaptationDecision.reason: Shares paired first-class leverage with cleared scissors, but grips rather than cuts. Nutcrackers and tweezers have different lever classes. Keep a fixed common pivot rather than adding a slip-joint construction.

prompt.note: Grip is faithful. Twist is possible but does not demonstrate the source mechanism. Move grip is ambiguous about what moves. Compare hand positions instead.
